name: Blizzard Challenge
ability_definition: The ability to communicate information and ideas in speaking so others will understand.

task_realism.reasoning: Reading provided text aloud resembles some real spoken work, such as audiobooks, announcements, IVR prompts and scripted narration. Most workplace oral expression, though, means explaining, briefing, persuading or answering questions with speech the speaker composes and adapts to listeners in real time. Isolated sentences, semantically unpredictable sentences and short passages are far from that.

evaluation_conditions.reasoning: Human listeners judge the speech, and the typed-transcription intelligibility tests directly check understanding, which is a real strength. However, listening happens in controlled conditions, usually over headphones, on short out-of-context stimuli. There is no background noise, no interaction, no listener feedback, and no follow-up questions. Nothing depends on whether the listener acts correctly on the information.

construct_coverage.reasoning: It covers only the delivery layer: intelligibility, naturalness and speaker similarity. It leaves out the core of the ability, which is choosing, organizing and conveying ideas so a listener understands them. Audience adaptation, clarity of explanation, turn-taking and responding to confusion are also missing. The primary reported metric is naturalness MOS rather than comprehension.

format_match.reasoning: The output is real spoken audio consumed by human listeners, which matches real work artifacts well. The inputs are fixed text scripts, including artificial semantically unpredictable sentences, and judgments are compressed into 1-5 MOS ratings or word transcriptions rather than task-relevant comprehension outcomes.

transferability_reasoning: The Blizzard Challenge validly measures whether synthesized speech is intelligible and natural to human listeners, which is a necessary component of Oral Expression, and its output format is genuine speech. It does not test forming, organizing or adapting the content of spoken communication. Its controlled, non-interactive listening tests also diverge from workplace conditions, so strong scores transfer only to scripted-delivery tasks.

2021.metric: Mean opinion score for naturalness on a 1–5 scale, averaged over all listeners
2021.human_reference: General adult workforce speaking read or prepared text aloud in work settings. The directly measured anchor is the professional recorded speaker whose natural speech set the benchmark ceiling.
